title: Georgia Boy, Brother Coleman and illness among clarinetists
summary: Discussion of a clarinetist with a heavy cough who died of consumption, and of Brother Coleman, a pianist from his childhood street.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
